lcc_original: 該南在世的日子、共有九百一十歲，然後死。
notes: H01961 (WAH01961+WTH8799) was implicit in UNV but LCC uses explicit 在世; dropped braces per Rule 3.
H03117 (days) was implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 日子; dropped braces per Rule 3.
Both H08141 instances (Hebrew שָׁנִים and שָׁנָה) collapse onto LCC's single 歲 per Rule 6.
然後 is a Chinese transitional phrase with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
有 in 共有 is Chinese grammar reinforcing the construction; H01961 already assigned to 在世 so 有 carries no SN.
